text:
katie_ops: Heads-up — inbound RMA batch from Nexa (6x 80GB) cleared customs in NL but staging flagged firmware mismatch: vendor shipped v1.2, we require v1.3 for our fleet images. Holding them in quarantine at AMS warehouse. Can we discuss options?

oliver_procure: Oof. Vendor ETA for replacements? any DR plan?

katie_ops: Nexa initially said 3–4 weeks for replacements. They offered two options: (1) we accept current cards and push a firmware rollback + compatibility shim (riskier), (2) they send known-good spares from DE pool (2–5 days) but charge expedited freight + holding fees.

maria_logistics: If spares come from DE, customs/HS code still OK within EU but we need AWB and insurance values. Also need explicit COA for firmware version to avoid reprovisioning failures at the rack.

sanjay_hw: From runtime side, v1.2 -> v1.3 delta includes microcode that affects ECC init sequence. Rolling back software shim increased error rate ~0.5% in our staging tests. Not ideal for production.

katie_ops: Agree — we should avoid shim in prod. Can we get temporary capacity from Dedicated pool to cover the 6 cards while we await replacements? Cost estimate vs expedite?

oliver_procure: Quick math: Dedicated pool hourly for 6x80GB ~ $6k/day. Expedited spares + freight + holding fee quoted by Nexa ~ $9k one-off. If replacements take >5 days, cheaper to buy expedited. But need to negotiate holding fee waiver for customs delay.

vendorbot: Nexa RMA update: Case #RMA-8942 created. Vendor response ETA: initial reply 1994567955.

nexasupply_rep: Hi team, sorry for the trouble. We can ship 4 spares from DE next-day and 2 from FR within 72h. We will absorb the freight if customs paperwork was our error; otherwise we request freight credit. Firmware mismatch looks like packing error on our SKU line. We propose crediting holding fees for up to 5 business days.

maria_logistics: Need formal AWB and proforma to pre-file transit. Also we must confirm HS code for replacements: 8473.30.80 seems to be what customs used for the original inbound. Confirming insurance value should match invoice.

sanjay_hw: If we get 4 next-day, that buys us time. Can ops swap 2 cards into staging racks to validate without risking prod?

katie_ops: Yes, we can validate swaps in staging cluster. Also require the vendor to provide signed firmware manifest and SHA256 for binaries. No flash without checksum match.

oliver_procure: I'll push negotiation: ask Nexa to waive holding fee and cover expedited freight for the 4 next-day spares, we absorb 2-day internal swap labor. If they refuse, escalate to credits on next invoice.

nexasupply_rep: Understood. I'll confirm by EOD. Also note: our QA flagged a small batch with v1.2 due to loader script mismatch. We're running 100% test on outgoing SKUs now.

maria_logistics: FYI, send AWB example to customs team in this format:```AWB: 1Z999AA10123456789
Carrier: DHL Express
Declared Value: EUR 40,000
Insurance: Carrier declared
HS Code: 84733080
COA: firmware-manifest-v1.3.pdf```

katie_ops: Perfect. Also add requirement: vendor to use bonded carrier and mark as "RMA replacement - no duties" in paperwork (to avoid VAT complications).

oliver_procure: I'll draft PO amendment: expedite 4 spares, credit holding fee for up to 5 days, vendor to provide signed firmware manifest + AWB/proforma before pickup.

sanjay_hw: One more item — if any replacement arrives with different microcode table, we reserve right to refuse and require immediate return at vendor expense.

nexasupply_rep: Acknowledged. I'll send formal PO confirmation and AWBs when shipments are booked. Apologies again, we'll cover the expedited leg if the mismatch originated from our packing line. 

katie_ops: Thanks — will stand by for the AWB and PO. Moving the 6 units to cold quarantine; staging team notified. :thumbsup:

oliver_procure: tagging @finance for potential credit note if holding fees apply.

vendorbot: RMA note appended: "awaiting AWB + firmware-manifest" (1994568110).
